overview: You came home before the play and found York and Gaunt still as fine as the nephew. You did not correct them. You left the differences for tomorrow. Sunday's dinner stands, the chronicle stays, and the comedy waits on Saturday. Gib had not moved.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the refusal to mend, and kept Sunday's terms.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Came home to the uncles, still as fine as the nephew
